text: Coffee with Helen. She's moved to Leeds now, works at the hospital there doing night shifts. Her brother Finn is living with her until he sorts his flat out. She reckons it'll be end of the month at the earliest, he keeps finding problems with every place. Helen's still doing her pottery class on Wednesdays and wants me to come along sometime, said she'd send me the details.

spans.text: end of the month at the earliest

text: Tiago's new puppy is called Biscuit, a beagle cross. Already chewed two pairs of his trainers. Vet jabs are sometime next week. Need to ask him how the first one goes.

spans.text: ask him how the first one goes

text: Long catch up with Ann and Bethany at the pub. Ann's gone vegan since January and is finding it easier than she expected. Bethany's still on the gluten free thing, she's coeliac so not optional. They both only drink oat lattes, noted for when they come round on 14 May.
Ravi said his cat Pepper has kidney trouble and is on a special diet now. He's pretty gutted about it. Check in with him end of the month.
Lwazi lives in Croydon, works for the council in planning. Wife is a teacher. Two kids, both at primary.

spans.text: works for the council in planning

text: Mustafa doesn't drink at all, so don't bring wine next time. He loves really strong black coffee and anything with pistachio.
Called Fiona. Her mum's having a hip replacement on the 3rd of June and Fiona is going down to Exeter to look after her for a fortnight. She sounded tired. Remind me to ring her once her mum's home.
Anjali and Nasser are hosting a curry night early March, all veggie because Anjali's mum is staying with them. Nasser's doing the cooking, she says he's been practising dals for weeks.
Dinner with Anan. Severe peanut allergy, carries an epipen. Also hates coriander, says it tastes like soap.
Rafael's dog Luna turns 10 on 21/09. He's throwing her a little party in the park, with dog cake. Seriously.

Bumped into Angela at the shop. She and Claire finally moved into the house in Didsbury, garden's tiny but they love it. Angela still at the bank, Claire teaching yoga part time. Their cat hated the move and hid under the bath for three days, but he's come round. They're having people over for a housewarming sometime in early March once the boxes are gone. Claire's mum is coming up from Kent for it.

spans.text: moved into the house in Didsbury

text: Karan's the one who can't do dairy, not Divya. Divya's actually vegetarian. Get it right this time when booking the table for Saturday.
Must buy dog food and pick up the dry cleaning before Thursday.
Barbara's budgie died over the weekend. She'd had him eleven years. Send her a card.

Jaya told me about her brother Aleksander, he's a chef in Krakow and runs a pierogi place near the old town. She says he's thinking of moving back to London over the summer. Her dad's not well either, heart stuff, so she's going out there sometime in October to see them both.

spans.text: runs a pierogi place near the old town

text: Jorge just got a rescue greyhound called Mabel. She's terrified of stairs. He's off work 2nd to 6th Nov to settle her in.
Esther's going teetotal for a bit, doctor's orders apparently. Fizzy elderflower is her thing now.

Hoang works remotely for a games company in Montreal, lives in Brighton. His partner Dong is a nurse at the Royal Sussex. They've got a cat called Pho, which is honestly the best name. Dong's parents live nearby in Hove and do Sunday lunch every week, Hoang says it's non negotiable. Dong is allergic to cats though, hence the antihistamines everywhere.

spans.text: works remotely for a games company in Montreal

text: Bruno's wedding is off. He and Sofia split up last week. He seemed okay but kept changing the subject. Should text him sometime next week just to see how he's doing.
Khadija's daughter is starting nursery on the 8th of January. Khadija's more nervous than the kid. Remind me to message her that morning.
Akira is Japanese but grew up in Manchester. Big into fermenting things, kimchi, kombucha, miso. Yuki is his sister, she's at uni in Glasgow doing medicine.

spans.text: at uni in Glasgow doing medicine

text: Quick one: Liam can't eat shellfish. Dong is pescatarian. For the BBQ end of the month.
Helen said Finn's kitten has been poorly, off her food for three days. Vet on Monday. Finn's a bit of a mess about it, he's had her since uni.
Mrs Morris next door is 80 on 17 April. Her son is organising a lunch at the Swan. She mentioned she'd love some new gardening gloves.

Saw Tiago and his girlfriend Fiona, they're moving to Bristol at the end of the month. He's transferring with work, she's still looking. Fiona's a bit anxious about it, she's never lived away from her family. Their leaving drinks are on the 24th at the Crown. I should get them a little something for the new place, maybe a plant.

spans.text: get them a little something for the new place

text: Ann's birthday is 30th July. She's mad about Earl Grey and fancy shortbread, so easy gift sorted.
Ravi's parents live in Leicester. His dad runs a sweet shop, his mum used to teach maths. Ravi's the youngest of four.

Call with Bethany. Her mum's diabetic now so Christmas dinner is a whole new thing for them. She's trying to plan a menu early December. Bethany's quite stressed about hosting this year. Don't forget to send her that sugar free pudding recipe.

spans.text: send her that sugar free pudding recipe

text: Lwazi's dog Simba got out on Sunday and was missing overnight, found him two streets away. All fine now.
Need to book my own flu jab sometime next week.
Uncle Mustafa is visiting from Cairo 12th to 26th of August. Staying with Nasser. He only eats halal and loves sweets, so baklava when we see him.

Lunch with Divya and Karan. Divya's started a new job at a law firm in Canary Wharf, two weeks in. Karan's training for the half marathon on 5 October and is off sugar completely till then. Remind me to text Karan good luck the night before.

spans.text: new job at a law firm in Canary Wharf

text: Anjali has two rabbits, Bean and Toast. One of them, Toast I think, needs a dental op on 19/11. She's worried because he's old.
Angela mentioned Claire's sister is getting married in Lisbon early June. Both of them are going, plus Angela's mum. She said they're dreading the flights with Claire's anxiety.
Anan lives with his grandparents in Leyton. Works nights at a warehouse while doing an Open University course in engineering.
Rafael's mum Barbara makes the best feijoada. She can't do spicy though, gives her heartburn. Rafael says she's been learning English at an evening class.

spans.text: learning English at an evening class

text: Catch up with Esther. She's adopting a second cat sometime over the summer, a ginger one from the shelter. Her first cat Mabel is apparently very jealous already. Esther works from home so she says it's fine. I'm feeding them while she's in Wales 9th to 13th August.
Hoang's dad is having a heart scan on 2 March. Hoang's driving him in. Ask Hoang how it went.
Jorge and his partner are both doing dry January and he's already miserable about it. Likes a proper ale normally.
Bruno said Sofia's puppy is called Churro. Sofia kept the dog after the break up, he's quite sad about that. Pretty sure he misses the dog more than her.
Fiona Kowalski from work has coeliac and is lactose intolerant. Remember for the team lunch.

Liam's going to Australia for three months from early February, visiting his brother Sam in Perth. Sam's wife is due in March so Liam wants to be there for that. Remind me to get something small for the baby before Liam goes.

spans.text: get something small for the baby

text: Dr Kim is retiring at the end of the year. Divya says the whole surgery is chipping in for a present. Should ask Divya how much people are putting in.

spans.text: ask Divya how much people are putting in

text: Khadija works at the airport, customs. Lives in Hounslow with her husband and three girls.
Yuki's hamster Mochi had its first birthday yesterday, she sent a photo of it with a tiny paper hat.
Akira's moving out of the flat on 31/10 and into a houseboat on the canal, of all things. He's buzzing about it. I'm helping him carry stuff that weekend.

Rang Helen. Her dog Rolo has been limping for a fortnight, x-ray booked for the 15th of November. Her husband thinks it's arthritis. She's quite worried, he's only six. Her kids are taking it hard too. I'll check in with her after the x-ray and maybe drop round some of those dog treats he likes.
Nasser is diabetic type 1, pump on his arm. Doesn't like being fussed over about food so don't make a thing of it.

spans.text: Doesn't like being fussed over about food

text: Bethany and her fiancé Liam set the date, 22 May next year, small do in Cornwall. Bethany wants no gifts, just donations to the dog rescue where they got their spaniel.

spans.text: wants no gifts, just donations to the dog rescue

text: Errands: post office, return the drill to Barbara's husband, buy oat milk.

spans.text: return the drill to Barbara's husband

text: Ravi has given up meat after watching some documentary. Week three. Wants recommendations for a decent vegan place in town. Send him the list.

Talked to Lwazi and his wife for ages at the school gate. They're from Durban originally, moved over in 2015. Their eldest has a nut allergy, really serious, so they check everything at parties. Lwazi says she's in the netball team now and has her first match on Saturday. He's nervous for her.
Ann's daughter is getting a puppy for her birthday on 4th April, Ann's sworn me to secrecy. Cockapoo apparently.
Mustafa Khan, Nasser's cousin, works as a pharmacist in Bolton. Two kids, both into football.

spans.text: works as a pharmacist in Bolton

text: Angela's old cat Smudge was put to sleep on Friday. She's devastated. Remind me to call her at the weekend.
Sofia's sister Jaya is doing a cooking course in Bologna over the summer, six weeks. Jaya can't stand mushrooms, which is funny for someone who wants to cook Italian.
My own plan for the week: batch cook on Sunday, gym Tuesday and Thursday, dentist on the 23rd.

Talked to Tiago again about Biscuit. Vet said he has a slight heart murmur but nothing to worry about yet, recheck in six months. Tiago's partner Bruno wants to get a second dog, Tiago is not convinced.

spans.text: wants to get a second dog

text: Claire said the party for Angela's 40th on 18 Jan is cancelled, Angela doesn't want a fuss. They're doing a quiet dinner in instead. Angela loves a Negroni, apparently, so a nice bottle of Campari could be the move.

spans.text: nice bottle of Campari could be the move

text: Esther's partner Hoang has just started at a vet practice in Hove. Esther says he comes home smelling of dog every night. She's a GP, so between them they cover all species.

spans.text: started at a vet practice in Hove
